axes.brief: Elected parliamentary institutions and operating courts coexist with military dominance, restricted opposition competition and weakened judicial accountability.
axes.counterEvidence: The2025FederalConstitutionalCourt is operational; new presidential/toprank immunities do not abolish prime-minister no-confidence or legally authorize a military coup.

answers.rationale: Actual multiparty elections and parliamentary selection coexist with military influence, manipulated competition and repression. Mixed response weighs operative votes against unequal implementation, not absence of all elections.
Constitutional electorate/parliament chooses government rather than an expert appointment panel; military influence is not an expert selection system.
Adult electoral franchise has no education/intelligence test; identity and religious/status discrimination remain separate qualifications.

Educated assumption: Legislative passage and rejection of ordinances constrain lawmaking, qualified by executive ordinance/emergency powers and political dominance. Disagreement with enacting rejected laws is likeliest; all current delegated exceptions were not inventoried.
Actual opposition restrictions and repression prevent equal campaign conditions despite retained multiparty candidacies.

Educated assumption: Parliamentary financial committees and opposition membership offer scrutiny, qualified by influence/repression. Exact practical opposition-specific2026investigation access was not measured.

Actual new FCCP/HighCourtconstitutional review operates, while political appointment/control, immunity and military-area exclusions constrain independence and reach. Mixed response distinguishes continued review from weakened independence.
Trade union leaders do not replace citizen/parliamentary government selection.

Educated assumption: Actual political/security exclusions and opposition repression suggest broad governing influence over party participation. Exact purely political-position exclusion rule was not retrieved, so agreement is moderate rather than unrestricted legal power claimed.

Educated assumption: Article48referendum needs PMinitiative and joint sitting approval, not a documented citizen law-repeal entitlement. Moderate disagreement reflects executive-led mechanism; all direct-law-repeal statutes were not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Strong executive/military national influence coexists with parliamentary/federal competences. Mixed response weighs concentrated practice and formal distributed powers, not sole legal authority over all major policy.
Article95defined parliamentary no-confidence removes prime minister; Article47also provides presidential misconduct removal, distinct from criminal prosecution immunity.

Educated assumption: Legislative approval limits emergency term extension while actual election delays and executive influence weaken safeguards. Political continuity alone is not a defined unilateral entitlement; complete current election postponement cases were not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Constitutional electoral/seat-vacancy framework does not establish general voter recall; executive-led referendum is distinct. Exact all local recall exceptions were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Prime minister remains parliamentary-accountable while military dominance and new lifetime presidential/toprank protections weaken accountability. Mixed response distinguishes offices and parliamentary removal from criminal immunity.

Educated assumption: Article6condemns constitutional subversion and current formal civilian government continues, while actual military dominance can determine government formation. Mixed law/practice is likeliest, not a new legal coup right from2025command amendments.

axes.brief: Constitutional liberties coexist with extensive security, assembly, content and detention restrictions.
axes.counterEvidence: Capital assembly law has territorial scope; SIMbiometrics are not universal online identification, and periodic judicial review differs from executive-only indefinite detention.

answers.rationale: Educated assumption: Drug prohibition and restrictive moral/security rules suggest limited self-regarding adult autonomy, qualified by lawful personal choices. Exact current all drug exceptions were not inventoried.

Educated assumption: Actual InvestigationforFairTrialAct judicial oversight permits serious-crime surveillance. Exact amended2026authorization thresholds were not consolidated, so moderate agreement is qualified.
Actual IslamabadAssemblyAct requires permission/designated areas and permits bans for disrupting movement/business, beyond emergency-access protection alone; regional procedures vary.
Constitutional expression exceptions and current prosecutions restrict offensive criticism of institutions; some lawful critical speech persists.
Educated assumption: Public-health powers and preventive regulation suggest self-protective adult mandates, qualified by rights safeguards. Exact primarily-self-benefit national rule was not found.

Educated assumption: Broad surveillance/security databases and weak privacy enforcement make long-term movement retention likely. Exact suspicion-free multi-year limit was not retrieved; no documented universal tracking claim.

Educated assumption: Police/road-security checks suggest random intoxication testing may be permitted. Exact no-suspicion alcohol-testing clause was not found; restrictive alcohol law alone is not direct proof.
Educated assumption: Preventive security detention/review machinery suggests court-backed prospective movement restrictions. Exact serious-risk-before-offence test was not separately retrieved.
Actual religious/morality online-content restrictions and blasphemy enforcement reject unrestricted access merely because adults choose it; not every objectionable item is prohibited.

Educated assumption: SIMbiometrics are mandatory but not universal government verification on all communication platforms. Access without that universal condition is likeliest; exact all-platform identity rules remain unverified.

Educated assumption: Security-area operations and police checks suggest credible-threat searches without individual suspicion, qualified by constitutional safeguards. Exact national/regional threshold remains unverified.
Actual IslamabadAct expressly allows bans based on credible violence/public-disorder reports, with written reasons and administrative appeal; scope is the capital territory.

Educated assumption: Domestic privacy rights coexist with broad search/security powers and raids. Mixed response reflects protection plus exceptions beyond immediate safety; exact warrant exception inventory was not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Official-secrecy/cybercrime restrictions and media intimidation suggest confidential misconduct disclosure lacks broad immunity. Expression rights qualify disagreement; exact current public-interest defence was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Regulated provincial/firearms licensing suggests permission is narrower than violence-history checks alone, qualified by lawful licensed ownership. Complete current arms-issuance criteria across provinces were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Article10preventive detention has judicial review-board safeguards while security detention and military-area review exclusions weaken practice. Mixed response reflects real review requirements and unchecked detention concerns, not blanket unlimited lawful detention.
